$comment: The theme CI's themed Lighthouse run sets (Admin v2 E4; scripts/lhci-theme.mjs, lighthouserc.themed.json): Simple mode from a dark green main, its Hover and Accent settled by the gate, the marquee slower and the reveal off. A far cry from Klein, with a much lighter accent than the brand's sky. The tokens are what packages/theme/compile.ts makes of the settings (tests/lib/lhciTheme.spec.ts holds them equal).
